meta.semantics: series[i] is the chart for the stats-vectors.json series case of the same name: 'kept' indexes its response points (line: those with a mean; stacked: those with answers); 'labelled' indexes 'kept' per chart width; labels are formatBucket(start) in 'tz'. stats[i] is the Overview for the stats case of the same name (dates in meta.summary_tz).

series.name: series everything mood filtered day Europe/London
series everything glasses filtered week America/Santiago

stats.name: stats everything from Santiago gap eve

synthetic.name: line: buckets without a mean are skipped
line: no bucket has a mean
stacked: a bucket without answers, and values no option has
